messages:
Maya: FYI NorraLabs onboarding — we're seeing p95 spikes during peak (they're hitting ~120 concurrent reqs). p50 90ms, p95 860ms, avg tokens per call ~420. Cost is ~1.8x forecast. Can we propose a proactive optimization plan (quant, model swap, routing)?
Liam: Can you drop the exact slice (time window + example prompt)? helps pick quant profiles.
Maya: Yep — last 30m: 11:20-11:50 UTC. Example prompt attached (short QA). Link: https://redwood.internal/metrics/norra/onboard/176888...
Ollie: Quick thought: two levers that won't change UX much — 1) q8_0 quantization on their base model, 2) route tail queries to Dedicated pool with smaller seq len optimization + burst to hosted. Also enable prefix KV caching for repetitive system prompts.
Ria (Norra): We're ok with up to ~3% change in output distribution as long as hallucination rate doesn't jump. Want to avoid user-visible regressions.
Liam: Understood. I'll run a quick eval vs their annotated promptset: float16 (current) vs q8_0 and q4_0. Expect ~1.6-2.2x token cost reduction on q8; p95 latency should drop ~25-40% on long tails.
Maya: If we do a model swap, suggestion is: main model -> 'redwood/base-llama-2-7b' (current) to 'redwood/base-llama-2-7b-quant-q8_0' for canary. If quality looks good, promote.
Ollie: Routing policy proposal (super small snippet):
```json
{
  "match": {"account_id": "norra-001"},
  "routes": [
    {"percent": 85, "deployment": "dedicated-small"},
    {"percent": 10, "deployment": "hosted-q8-canary"},
    {"percent": 5, "deployment": "hosted-fallback"}
  ],
  "fallback": "hosted-fallback"
}
```
Maya: Also recommend <= 10% canary initially, A/B measurement on: token-efficiency, p95 latency, and a small quality eval (10 prompts from their gold set).
Liam: I'll queue the eval run now. Command I'm using: `rwctl eval run --account norra-001 --model redwood/base-llama-2-7b-quant-q8_0 --prompts ./norra_goldset.json --metrics latency,kl,exact_match`
deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated for redwood/base-llama-2-7b-quant-q8_0 (canary-id: c-2026-1768888900)
Ria (Norra): Sending approval for 10% canary and schedule — QA team will monitor hallucination/regressions for 24h.
Ollie: Let's add a quick guardrail rule: if regression in EM > 1.5% or hallucinations increase by >1% send rollback alert and route 100% to hosted-fallback.
Maya: Noted — I'll create a ticket in SupportOps with that rollback policy and capture who's owning monitoring (Liam for eval, Norra QA for manual checks).
Liam: Eval kicked off. Will paste results in this thread when complete. If q8 looks bad, fallback plan is q4_0 only for token-heavy endpoints (embedding-heavy or sampling calls).
Ria (Norra): Thanks all — also can we get a short enablement doc for our engineers describing the routing change and how to toggle traffic? Prefer a 1-pager.
Ollie: I'll draft a 1-pager + a tiny runbook for toggling the route via Console and `rwctl`. Aim to share before the canary.
Maya: Great. Follow-ups: 1) Liam posts eval results (eta ~20m). 2) Ollie posts runbook. 3) I'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT with Norra ENG + CS.
Ria (Norra): 10am PT works. Appreciated.
Liam: Eval done — q8_0: median token cost -48%, p95 latency -32% on canary hardware. Tiny drop in EM (~0.6%). Uploading CSV now.
Maya: :thumbsup: that's within the threshold Ria mentioned. proceeding to roll 10% canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 10% for c-2026-1768888900 at 1768888912
Ollie: I'll monitor dashboards and set an alert for the rollback guardrail. If anything suspicious, call the on-call and @here.
Maya: I'll capture customer feedback and close the loop in the renewal playbook. Thanks team.
Ria (Norra): Thanks everyone, feels proactive — we'll report any quality concerns.
